title: Multisig Scams Explained and How to Stay Safe
subTitle:
Multisignature wallets are widely described as a security upgrade in crypto. By requiring approval from multiple keys before any transfer can happen, they are meant to protect funds from a single point of failure. While this design is genuinely powerful, scammers have learned how to twist it into a convincing deception. Multisig scams take advantage of excitement, lack of technical understanding, and the promise of easy money, and they continue to catch unsuspecting users every day.
Knowing how these scams operate is the strongest defense you can have.
How Multisignature Wallets Really Function
A multisig wallet does not rely on one private key. Instead, it requires confirmation from several different keys to approve a transaction. For example, a wallet might need two out of three signers, or three out of five, before funds can move.
This setup is commonly used by companies, DAOs, investment groups, and families who want shared responsibility and transparency. When used honestly, multisig wallets improve security and trust. When abused, they become the perfect cover for scams.
What Makes a Multisig Scam Work
In a multisig scam, the victim is given access that looks real but is functionally useless. Scammers provide a private key or seed phrase that belongs to a wallet holding funds, but that key alone does not have the authority to move anything.
These traps often appear in public comments, private messages, or group chats. A scammer may claim they mistakenly leaked a seed phrase tied to a wallet showing a large balance. To someone unfamiliar with multisig mechanics, it looks like a rare opportunity. In reality, the wallet was designed so the victim can never withdraw the funds.
That false sense of access is the bait.
Why Tron Is a Popular Target
These scams are especially common on the Tron network due to how account permissions are structured. Tron allows very detailed control over what each address can do, including separating balance visibility from transfer authority.
In many cases, the wallet shows assets like USDT, but the true owner permissions remain with an address controlled by the scammer. The victim only holds a restricted key that cannot approve outgoing transactions, no matter what they try.
The Gas Fee Setup
One of the most effective multisig scams revolves around transaction fees rather than stolen keys. A victim imports a shared seed phrase into a wallet such as Trust Wallet or SafePal and sees a large token balance. However, there is no TRX available to pay network fees.
Thinking the solution is simple, the victim sends a small amount of TRX to cover gas costs. Once that transfer is completed, nothing changes. The funds remain locked, and the scammer benefits from the deposited fees. The victim never gains control.
Warning Signs You Should Never Ignore
A major red flag is anyone publicly sharing private keys or seed phrases. Legitimate wallet owners do not give away access to wallets holding value.
Another danger sign is being nudged to send funds to “activate,” “unlock,” or “enable” a wallet. Crypto does not work that way. If you do not fully control a wallet, no amount of gas will fix it.
Blockchain explorers can also expose these scams. On TronScan, checking owner and permission details often reveals that another address holds full authority. If that address is not yours, the wallet is not yours.
How to Protect Yourself
Awareness is your strongest protection. Never import a seed phrase or private key that did not originate from you, even “just to check.” That curiosity is exactly what scammers count on.
Always use official wallet apps and verified extensions. Fake wallets and cloned apps are frequently paired with multisig scams to increase damage. Double-check download sources and URLs every time.
If you use multisig wallets legitimately, review permissions regularly. Remove inactive signers, revoke old approvals, and avoid unnecessary access. For large holdings, combining multisig wallets with hardware devices adds another strong layer of safety.
Many modern wallets now warn users about restricted or unusual multisig configurations. Do not ignore these alerts. They exist for a reason.
Closing Thoughts
Multisignature wallets themselves are not dangerous. When understood and used correctly, they are among the most reliable security tools in crypto. The real risk comes from misunderstanding how control and permissions actually work.
Scams succeed by creating urgency and emotional pressure. Slowing down, verifying ownership, and refusing to interact with wallets you do not fully control can prevent nearly all losses. With the right knowledge, multisig remains a safeguard, not a snare.

This scene reminds me of the last bull market's journey. At the end of 2018, Bitcoin bottomed out, the bear market ended, and the bull market began to show signs of life. In 2019, Bitcoin experienced a several-fold increase, and the market was optimistic, believing the bull market would continue the slow bull trend of 2015-2017.
However, the '312' crash on March 12, 2020, shattered this illusion. The market was in panic, and people were selling at a loss, believing blockchain was a scam and that Bitcoin was nothing special; 2017 was the peak of the industry.

But just when everyone was pessimistic, Bitcoin continued to rise from $3,000, breaking through $5,000, $8,000, $12,000, and $20,000. People around me kept saying this was just a rebound, yet they watched Bitcoin continuously set new highs, ultimately having to admit that the bull market had truly arrived.
At the beginning of 2021, Bitcoin rose to $40,000-$50,000, while altcoins performed mediocrely. Many only bought Bitcoin, which led to a situation where between February and April 2021, Bitcoin consolidated sideways while altcoins surged, with many coins increasing by dozens or even hundreds of times.

Only by deeply analyzing the industry's value and studying the value of the coins you invest in can you succeed.
For retail investors, the main players and large institutions are not so kind; they do not want to help you make money but will try every means to make you their target for losses.

Recently, the market has been fluctuating wildly, making strategy even more important. Let’s be steady, patient, and decisive in our actions.

When countries start creating crypto banks,
the question is no longer if crypto wins —

💥 BREAKING: White House Says Denmark Cannot Defend or Control Greenland
The White House has delivered a shockwave across global geopolitics by stating that Denmark lacks the capacity to defend or effectively control Greenland.
This is not a casual diplomatic comment — it is a strategic declaration that repositions Greenland as a critical security asset rather than a passive autonomous territory.
This single statement changes the rules of the game in the Arctic.
🌍 Greenland Has Entered the Global Power Chessboard
Greenland is no longer viewed as a distant icy landmass. It is now one of the most strategically valuable regions on Earth due to four irreversible trends:
Arctic militarization is accelerating
Global powers are racing for rare earth dominance
Climate change is unlocking new shipping routes
Missile defense and space surveillance depend on Arctic positioning
Greenland sits at the intersection of all four.
🇺🇸 Why the United States Is Speaking So Directly
The U.S. is signaling urgency because time is no longer neutral.
Russia has expanded Arctic bases, radar systems, and hypersonic coverage
China is embedding itself economically as a “near-Arctic stakeholder”
NATO defenses in the far north remain fragmented
Denmark lacks the force projection needed for 21st-century Arctic threats
By publicly stating Denmark cannot defend Greenland, the U.S. is reframing responsibility.
This is a warning — and an invitation.
🇩🇰 Denmark’s Control Is Legal, Not Strategic
On paper, Greenland is part of the Kingdom of Denmark.
In reality:
Denmark does not possess sufficient Arctic naval power
Air response times are slow and infrastructure is limited
Surveillance depends heavily on U.S. systems
Greenland’s local government increasingly favors autonomy
The White House is effectively acknowledging that real control equals security capability, not legal ownership.
❄️ Greenland Is the Backbone of Western Defense
Greenland hosts:
Early-warning missile detection systems
Critical space and satellite monitoring infrastructure
Strategic airfields connecting North America and Europe
If Greenland were compromised, NATO’s northern defense shield would fracture.
That risk is no longer hypothetical.
🧨 What This Means for Global Markets
Geopolitical shifts at this scale ripple directly into financial systems:
Defense spending accelerates
Commodity and rare earth prices rise
Energy routes are repriced
Sovereign risk models change
Hard assets outperform fiat-dependent instruments
Historically, moments like this drive capital toward scarce, neutral, borderless assets.
📈 Why Crypto Benefits From This Shift
When geopolitical uncertainty rises:
Trust in centralized systems weakens
Governments expand strategic reserves
Neutral settlement layers gain relevance
Investors hedge against currency and policy risk
Bitcoin and major crypto assets thrive in environments where power blocs compete and monetary neutrality matters.
Greenland’s situation reinforces the broader macro thesis:
The world is fragmenting — and digital scarcity becomes more valuable.
🔥 Big Picture Takeaway
This is not about Denmark alone.
This is about:
Arctic dominance
Global security realignment
Strategic resources
Monetary hedging
The future balance of power
The White House just pulled Greenland into the center of global strategy.
Markets are watching. Governments are recalculating.
And capital is already positioning.

content:
Does Ethereum have enough strength to conquer the $4,100 mark?
The possibility that we will see Ethereum move up to the $4,100 range is being discussed quite a bit, but signals from the market indicate that professional traders have not really bet on this scenario.
In the past week, ETH hit the $3,400 mark before facing profit-taking pressure and adjusting around 4%. This drop caused approximately $65 million in long leveraged positions to be liquidated, reflecting a still quite sensitive market sentiment.
In the futures market, the one-month ETH contracts are trading only about 4% higher than the spot price.
With Ethereum, a premium below 5% often indicates relatively weak bullish expectations, or at least a lack of confidence in a clear breakout in the short term. The options market is sending similar signals when put options are priced higher than calls by about 6%, slightly leaning towards a defensive scenario.
On-chain data does not provide much support. The number of transactions on the base layer surged last month, but total network fees dropped sharply, indicating increased activity that the economic value created has not kept pace.
Meanwhile, competing ecosystems like Solana, BNB Chain, or even Base do not show superior momentum for Ethereum.
My personal view is that $ETH   has not fallen into a “bad” state, but it is clearly not yet qualified for a convincing strong rally.
If there is no clear boost from new cash flow or a substantial recovery of network fees and staking yields, the $4,100 mark is likely to remain more of an expectation than a base scenario in the short term.

quoteContent.title: Bitcoin Profit-Taking Dominates Market Amid Low Loss Rates
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly: According to ChainCatcher, Crypto Quant analyst Axel reported that approximately 35,400 profitable Bitcoins flowed into centralized exchanges (CEX) in the past 24 hours, marking the highest level in nearly two months. In contrast, the outflow of loss-making tokens was significantly lower, at around 4,600. The profit-to-loss outflow ratio stands at approximately 7.5:1, indicating that profit-taking is the dominant market behavior, with minimal panic selling.Axel explained that high levels of profit-taking amid low loss rates is a logical market behavior. Investors who purchased in the $85,000–$92,000 range are seizing the opportunity to lock in profits as prices approach their cost line. This flow structure suggests that profit-taking is the primary driver of market pressure, differing fundamentally from the pressure caused by panic selling from loss positions. Should the profit-to-loss ratio reverse, with loss-driven selling becoming dominant, a bearish scenario could intensify, although this is not a certainty.The charts depict a coherent picture, with loss rates narrowing to their lowest levels. It is precisely in this range that profit-taking becomes active. Prices are testing the cost benchmark area while facing high supply pressure from profitable positions.

title: Ethereum’s 2026 Roadmap: Finally, We’re Getting Our Privacy Back
subTitle:
I’ve been following the space for a long time, and honestly, it feels like we’ve spent years sacrificing decentralization just to make things faster. But today, it feels like the tide is finally turning. Vitalik Buterin just dropped the 2026 Ethereum Strategic Plan, and it’s a massive win for everyone who actually cares about self-sovereignty and privacy.
If you’re holding $ETH , this isn't just another technical update—it’s a shift back to what crypto was supposed to be about in the first place. Here’s the breakdown of what's coming:
Making Nodes Accessible Again
Let’s be real: running a node has become way too hard for the average person. It’s mostly been left to big players with heavy hardware. By 2026, the plan is to use ZK-EVM and BAL technology to lower those barriers. The goal? Making it so almost anyone can help secure the network from home. That’s what real decentralization looks like.
Privacy is No Longer an Afterthought
Privacy has always been the "missing piece" of Ethereum. We’ve all just accepted that our data is out there. But the 2026 roadmap introduces ORAM and PIR—basically, tools that let you pull data without letting third-party providers track exactly what you're looking for. It’s about time we had a choice in how much we reveal.
A Network That Doesn't Need a "Boss"
Vitalik is pushing for "Ossifiability." It’s a big word, but it just means making the network so stable and solid that it can run for decades without needing developers to constantly step in. An "unstoppable" network needs to be able to stand on its own two feet, and that’s the 2026 target.
Looking at the Market Today (Jan 17, 2026)
$ETH  is hovering around $3,296 right now, down slightly today (~0.48%). But looking past the daily candles, these upgrades are what actually build long-term value. This is about Ethereum proving it’s still the "World Computer" and not just another speculative asset.

I’m curious to hear your thoughts—is this focus on privacy exactly what we need for the next bull run, or do you think the tech is getting too complicated?
Drop a "YES" in the comments if you’re still bullish on $ETH for 2026! 👇

Ethereum Today: Growth, Confidence, and Market Momentum
Ethereum (ETH) is the second-largest cryptocurrency in the world and a key driver of the blockchain economy. In recent weeks, ETH’s price has shown strength and is trading around the $3,300–$3,400 range, reflecting renewed buying interest after holding strong support levels.
One of the biggest trends behind this move is strong staking activity — a significant portion of Ethereum’s supply is now locked up, reducing sell pressure and signaling confidence among long-term investors. 
Beyond price action, Ethereum’s network usage is rising. Active addresses and transaction levels have spiked, showing more people and projects are using ETH for real-world services like decentralized finance.
Experts also highlight that Ethereum’s ecosystem upgrades and Layer-2 growth make the network faster and cheaper to use. These improvements help it stay relevant as more people build apps and financial products on Ethereum. 
Large firms and institutional players are increasingly involved too. Some major treasuries and investment funds are staking or holding ETH, which adds more stability and long-term demand.
Despite occasional sideways moves or short-term pullbacks, many analysts believe Ethereum’s fundamentals remain strong as the blockchain continues to expand. 
In short, Ethereum is not just about price — it’s growing in real usage, adoption, and technical strength. As the crypto market evolves, ETH remains at the center of digital finance and blockchain innovation.

title: Бутерин:  Ethereum вернется к своим истокам
subTitle:
В 2026 году $ETH  намерен вернуть себе ключевые позиции в вопросах децентрализации и доверия, заявил сооснователь проекта Виталик Бутерин. По его словам, платформа больше не будет идти на компромиссы с базовыми ценностями ради ускоренного массового внедрения.
«Все те моменты, когда приходилось задумываться, стоит ли размывать принципы ради популярности, мы больше не будем игнорировать», — подчеркнул Бутерин.
В числе приоритетов развития он назвал улучшение приватных платежей, снижение сложности запуска полной ноды и создание условий для работы приложений без привлечения централизованных серверов. Особое внимание будет уделено пользовательскому контролю над личными данными и усовершенствованию процессов социального восстановления средств на случай потери или кражи сид-фразы.
По словам Бутерина, в ряде ключевых направлений #Ethereum  за последние десять лет сделал шаг назад. «Запуск нод стал сложнее, а децентрализованные приложения превратились из простых страниц в громоздкие системы, передающие ваши данные на десятки серверов», — отметил он.
Часть этих проблем планируется решить с помощью нового стека инструментов Kohaku и предстоящего хардфорка Glamsterdam. Бутерин добавил, что путь будет долгим, но эти меры позволят превратить Ethereum в экосистему, которая сможет не только удерживать нынешние позиции, но и существенно расширить влияние в мире блокчейна.
Ранее, в январе, Бутерин также предложил концепцию самоподдерживающегося блокчейна, которая станет частью стратегии дальнейшего развития платформы.

📉 Crypto Market Turns Bearish After Recent Correction
According to BlockBeats, data from Coinglass (January 17) shows that the crypto market sentiment has shifted toward bearishness following a two-day price correction. Funding rates across both centralized (CEX) and decentralized exchanges (DEX) indicate growing caution among traders, with altcoins facing the strongest negative pressure 🧊📉.
Funding rates play a crucial role in the derivatives market. They are used by trading platforms to keep perpetual contract prices aligned with the spot price of the underlying asset. Instead of the exchange charging a fee, funds are exchanged directly between long and short traders, helping balance market positions ⚖️.
A 0.01% funding rate is considered neutral. When funding rates rise above this level, it usually reflects bullish sentiment 🐂. However, when rates fall below 0.005%, it signals bearish market expectations 🐻. Current data suggests traders are positioning defensively, especially in the altcoin market 🚨.

title: 2026年1月17日加密貨幣市場每日快訊
subTitle:
比特幣穩守9.5萬美元大關，市場等待美國監管進展
加密貨幣市場今日整體呈現窄幅震盪格局，總市值約3.22兆至3.31兆美元，較前一日小幅下跌0.3%。比特幣（BTC）維持在95,000美元附近盤整，以太坊（ETH）和Solana（SOL）等主流幣種小幅上揚。
市場焦點集中在美國國會加密貨幣法案進展，以及機構資金持續流入的跡象。X平台（前Twitter）上，熱門討論圍繞meme幣回暖、Solana生態空投活動，以及機構對比特幣的持續累積。

今日主要幣種價格與漲跌概況
▪︎$BTC 比特幣（BTC）：價格約95,164美元，24小時上漲0.47%，過去7天下漲5.14%。市值1.9兆美元，佔比約59%。
▪︎以太坊（ETH）：價格約3,294美元，24小時上漲0.42-0.5%，過去7天下漲6.72%。市值約3976億美元。
▪︎$Solana（SOL）：價格約144.3美元，24小時上漲0.93%，過去7天下漲6.09%。Solana生態近期交易量活躍，meme幣表現突出。
▪︎XRP：價格約2.06美元，24小時上漲0.27%，過去7天下漲1.37%。XRP Ledger生態被視為近期漲幅領先板塊之一。
▪︎BNB：價格約937美元，24小時上漲0.27%，過去7天下漲4.3%。
▪︎Dogecoin（DOGE）：價格約0.1375美元，24小時上漲1.46%，過去7天下漲1.62%。meme幣板塊整體回暖，DOGE交易量顯著放大。
▪︎TRON（TRX）：價格約0.31美元，24小時上漲0.9%，過去7天下漲4.24%。
其他穩定幣如USDT與USDC價格穩定，24小時交易量合計超過740億美元，顯示市場流動性充裕。

近期漲跌分析與展望
1.比特幣（BTC）
短期支撐強勁，機構持續買入。BlackRock等ETF產品近期單週流入超過10億美元，顯示大資金在95,000美元下方積極建倉。若美國監管法案順利推進，比特幣有望挑戰10萬美元關卡；反之，若法案持續延宕，可能面臨獲利了結壓力，短期回落風險至90,000美元附近。

2.以太坊（ETH）
過去7天漲幅領先主流幣，受益於Vitalik Buterin公開表示2026年將優先推進去中心化進程。技術面顯示ETH正測試關鍵阻力，若突破3,400美元，可望延續上漲動能。短期看漲，但需留意整體市場風險偏好變化。

3.Solana（SOL）
生態熱度持續，X平台上多數熱門貼文提及Solana相關空投與meme幣活動。過去7天漲幅達6%，交易量放大。meme幣板塊市值從去年底低點反彈近10億美元，Solana作為主要載體受益明顯。短期內若meme熱潮延續，SOL有機會測試150-160美元區間；但槓桿過高也帶來快速回調風險。

4.其他熱門幣種
▪︎XRP：受Ripple生態與潛在監管利好支撐，短期穩健。
▪︎DOGE與meme幣：X平台討論顯示，meme幣交易量暴增300%，為2026年開年首波熱錢流向。短期高Beta特性明顯，適合短線操作，但易受情緒波動影響。
今日市場熱點新聞
▪︎美國加密法案再傳波折：參議院委員會因Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong反對而延後表決。Armstrong指稱銀行業遊說導致條文不利穩定幣收益，市場因此出現風險規避情緒，導致比特幣一度跌破95,000美元。
▪︎機構動向：Anchorage Digital傳出計畫募資2-4億美元，為潛在IPO做準備；BlackRock等機構持續增持比特幣ETF。
▪︎X平台熱議：今日熱門話題包括meme幣復甦（DOGE、PEPE、WIF等）、Solana生態空投（如$FOGO、$STRK staking）、以及交易者對市場「恐懼」與「機會」的討論。多名KOL指出，當前恐懼情緒與價格脫節，往往預示上行空間。

市場總結與風險提示
加密貨幣市場開年以來呈現恢復態勢，總市值已從去年底低點反彈，但美國監管不確定性仍為最大變數。短期內，投資人可關注法案最新進展與機構資金流向。中性情緒主導（恐懼與貪婪指數50），建議分散配置主流幣種，並嚴控槓桿風險。
（本文僅供資訊參考，不構成投資建議。加密貨幣價格波動劇烈，請自行評估風險。）

title: Bitcoin Price Recovers, but Miners Remain on the Edge as Hashprice Hovers Near Breakeven
subTitle:
As 2026 begins, Bitcoin miners are once again navigating a familiar — yet increasingly unforgiving — landscape. Network hashrate has cooled from its late-2025 peak, difficulty adjustments continue to lag by design, and electricity costs remain the hard constraint determining who can stay online and who is forced to shut down.
From the surface, market conditions may appear stable, especially with Bitcoin’s price showing signs of recovery. Beneath that calm, however, miner economics sit on a razor’s edge. A single upward difficulty adjustment or a localized electricity price shock can quickly turn “operational” miners into load-reducing participants.
Hashrate Cools After the Late-2025 Peak
Bitcoin’s network hashrate has struggled to sustain the record levels reached at the end of 2025, even during periods of spot price recovery.
According to JPMorgan estimates, Bitcoin’s average monthly hashrate rose 5% in October 2025, reaching 1,082 EH/s — the highest monthly average ever recorded in the bank’s dataset. In November, hashrate eased slightly to 1,074 EH/s, signaling a modest adjustment rather than a continuation of uninterrupted growth.
From late December into January, daily estimates have shown heightened volatility, with hashrate oscillating around the 1,000 EH/s threshold. This pattern suggests miners are increasingly cycling uptime rather than expanding capacity smoothly.
Data from YCharts (sourced from Blockchain.com) confirms multiple dips below 1,000 EH/s, followed by recoveries above that level during Bitcoin’s mid-January price rebound.
Key hashrate snapshots:
October 2025 (monthly avg): 1,082 EH/s — record high (JPMorgan estimate)
November 2025 (monthly avg): 1,074 EH/s — mild pullback
January 2026 (7-day avg): 1,024 EH/s — short-term cooling
Hashprice — Not Bitcoin Price — Determines Miner Survival
Miner behavior today is driven less by Bitcoin’s spot price and far more by hashprice, which measures expected daily revenue per unit of hashrate. Hashprice determines whether the least efficient machines can continue operating without incurring losses.
In its January 12 weekly report, Luxor noted that USD-denominated hashprice declined from $40.23 to $39.53 per PH/s/day, a level described as “at or near breakeven for many miners.”
This explains why network conditions can remain fragile even when Bitcoin’s price stabilizes or rebounds — miner profitability remains tightly compressed.
Luxor also reported that Bitcoin fell 2.9% week-over-week to approximately $91,132, coinciding with hashprice compression and adding pressure on miners with inflexible cost structures. Over the same period, Luxor’s 7-day average hashrate dropped 2.8%, from 1,054 EH/s to 1,024 EH/s.
The Late-2025 Difficulty Shock Still Lingers
Context from late 2025 remains critical. Luxor research previously highlighted that Bitcoin difficulty reached an all-time high following a 6.31% upward adjustment on October 29, pushing difficulty to 155.97T.
In November, however, hashprice deteriorated as transaction fees and Bitcoin’s price failed to offset the higher difficulty. Data from the Hashrate Index showed hashprice falling to record lows near $36 per PH/day.
While early 2026 has seen a modest recovery from those lows, the rebound remains narrow. As a result, the recovery in hashrate since October has been uneven. Many miners now operate precisely at the margin, where even minor differences in electricity pricing determine whether machines stay online.
Machine-Level Reality Check
The sensitivity of miner economics becomes clearer when hashprice is translated into per-machine revenue and compared against electricity costs.
Using Luxor’s 6-month average hashprice assumption of $38.2 per PH/s/day and a reference electricity price of $0.0902/kWh (U.S. industrial average, September 2025, EIA), the economics look stark:

This does not imply that all miners are unprofitable. Operators with cheaper power, demand-response revenue, or superior operational efficiency remain viable.
The key variable is the marginal miner — the group that determines hashrate volatility. At current hashprice levels, these miners increasingly resemble flexible load participants rather than always-on infrastructure.
Difficulty Lag: A Structural Constraint
Bitcoin difficulty adjusts only once every 2,016 blocks (roughly two weeks), meaning it cannot respond immediately to changes in hashrate or price.
This lag forces miners to endure unfavorable hashprice conditions for an entire epoch before relief arrives, compressing margins during downturns and slowing recoveries.
In early January, difficulty fell 1.20% to 146.4T, marking the first adjustment of 2026. However, projections suggest the January 22 adjustment could push difficulty back up toward 148.20T.
Meanwhile, futures markets signal limited relief. Luxor reports that 6-month forward hashprice is priced around $38.19, below the current spot level of $39.53, implying limited short-term upside unless a major variable shifts — higher Bitcoin prices, higher fees, lower difficulty, or cheaper power.
The emerging pattern resembles a network whiplash: falling hashprice weakens hashrate, difficulty reacts slowly, and miners absorb poor economics for an entire cycle before protocol-level rebalancing occurs.
Electricity Costs: The Ultimate Pressure Point
If hashprice defines what the network pays, electricity determines what miners actually keep.
Luxor estimates revenue per MWh of electricity by fleet efficiency as follows:
Below 19 J/TH: ~$97/MWh
19–25 J/TH: ~$75/MWh
25–38 J/TH: ~$51/MWh
This matters because power prices vary dramatically by region and contract type. The IEA estimates average wholesale power prices in the U.S. around $48/MWh in H1 2025, compared with roughly $90/MWh in the EU, with 2026 forward contracts near $80/MWh.
For miners operating at 25–38 J/TH, ~$51/MWh leaves little margin for error. Any increase in realized power costs or basis risk can trigger rapid curtailment.
Negative power pricing — increasingly common in parts of Europe — highlights the advantage of flexible miners capable of rapid on/off cycling, demand response participation, or behind-the-meter generation.
Texas: A Strategic Region with Policy Risk
Texas remains one of the most critical jurisdictions for Bitcoin mining, where grid policy and interconnection access directly shape economics.
Under Texas Senate Bill 6, ERCOT can require new large loads (≥75 MW, connected after December 31, 2025) to curtail or rely on backup power during grid emergencies. Existing facilities are exempt.
Meanwhile, ERCOT’s load interconnection queue exceeded 230 GW in 2025, with over 70% attributed to data centers. The IEA has warned that data centers will be the largest driver of global electricity demand growth through 2026.
For miners, this increases the value of existing grid connections and stable contracts, while making expansion more challenging without carefully negotiated curtailment and interconnection terms.
What to Watch Next
Upcoming difficulty epochs: Lagged adjustments could either ease pressure or exacerbate stress if difficulty rises while hashprice stalls.
Hashprice stability: The $39–40/PH/day zone marks breakeven for many miners, while the forward curve near $38 leaves little buffer.
Electricity volatility: Fleets in the 25–38 J/TH range face the highest risk.
ERCOT curtailment risk: Emergency authority under SB 6 could trigger sudden hashrate drops independent of Bitcoin price.
Data center competition: Rising power demand may restrict access to low-cost electricity for miners.
At present, the key reference points remain hashprice at $39.53/PH/day, Bitcoin near $91,132, and 7-day average hashrate at 1,024 EH/s.
These variables set the stage for the next difficulty adjustment — a moment when miners must once again decide whether to stay online, curtail operations, or wait for the protocol’s delayed rebalancing to arrive.
With 1,082 EH/s from October 2025 still standing as the most recent record, the central question persists:
Can the network regain and surpass that level, or will cost pressures keep hashrate locked in a prolonged tug-of-war?

content:
A digital signature proves that digital data is authentic, unchanged, and signed by the real owner. Think of it as a tamper-proof, math-based signature—far stronger than ink on paper.
🧱 The Building Blocks
🧬 Hash Functions → turn data into a unique digital fingerprint
🔁 Tiny change = totally different hash
🚨 Any tampering is instantly detectable
🔑 Public-Key Cryptography
🔒 Private key signs the data
🔓 Public key verifies the signature
⚙️ How It Works (3 Steps)
🧾 Hash the message → create a fingerprint
✍️ Sign the hash with the sender’s private key
✅ Verify using the sender’s public key
If verification passes, the message is real and untouched 👍
🛡️ Why Digital Signatures Matter
They provide:
🧱 Integrity → data wasn’t altered
🧍 Authentication → proves who signed it
🚫 Non-repudiation → signer can’t deny it later
🌍 Where They’re Used
📧 Secure emails & software updates
💳 Finance, contracts, audits
🏥 Healthcare records
⛓️ Blockchains & crypto (e.g. Bitcoin uses digital signatures so only owners can spend funds)
⚠️ Risks & Limits
🔐 Private key security is critical
🕳️ Key loss or leaks = serious damage (or lost crypto forever)
🧑‍💻 Weak implementations can break strong crypto
✍️ Digital vs Electronic Signatures
📄 Electronic signature = any digital agreement (typed name, checkbox)
🔐 Digital signature = cryptographic, verifiable, and secure

title: Two Solo Bitcoin Miners Hit Rare $300,000 “Jackpot” in the Same Week
subTitle:
Two independent Bitcoin miners achieved a rare feat this week, each successfully mining a block on their own and earning the full block reward worth nearly $300,000 per block. Such outcomes are considered extremely uncommon in today’s Bitcoin mining landscape, which is largely dominated by large-scale mining pools.
According to publicly available blockchain data and mempool trackers, one solo miner discovered a block early Thursday, receiving a total reward of 3.157 BTC, including transaction fees. Another solo miner earlier in the week secured a block payout valued at approximately $295,000, based on Bitcoin’s market price at the time.
Why Solo Mining Wins Are So Rare
In the modern Bitcoin network, most miners choose to join mining pools to smooth out income volatility. By pooling hashrate, miners receive smaller but more consistent payouts proportional to their contribution.
Solo miners, on the other hand, face extremely low odds of finding a block due to the massive total network hashrate. However, when a solo miner does succeed, they receive 100% of the block reward and transaction fees, without sharing it with others—making such wins feel like a true “jackpot.”
Despite the low probability, Bitcoin’s proof-of-work mechanism remains fundamentally probabilistic. Higher hashrate increases the likelihood of finding a block, but there is never a guarantee as to who will mine the next one.
Mining Pools Still Dominate the Network
Data from mempool monitoring platforms shows that the vast majority of Bitcoin blocks continue to be mined by a small number of major pools, including Foundry USA, AntPool, and F2Pool. This concentration leaves solo miners and smaller operators with only a marginal chance of regularly securing blocks.
Nonetheless, the recent back-to-back solo mining successes serve as a reminder that the network remains open and permissionless—any participant, regardless of size, technically has a chance to mine a block.
Shifting Dynamics in the Global Mining Industry
The timing of these rare wins is notable, as the global Bitcoin mining industry is undergoing structural changes. The United States’ dominance in Bitcoin mining shows signs of softening, with some publicly listed mining companies reallocating computing resources toward artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads.
Meanwhile, other regions—including pools with historical or operational ties to China—have been gradually reclaiming market share, according to recent industry tracking reports. These shifts highlight an evolving competitive landscape, even as overall network security remains robust.
A Reminder of Bitcoin’s Core Design
While unlikely to inspire a widespread return to solo mining, these events underscore a key principle of Bitcoin’s design: no miner is guaranteed success, and no miner is excluded by default. The protocol continues to reward both scale and luck, reinforcing its decentralized and open nature.

title: Nỗi Đau Cắt Lỗ ! Làm Sao Để Vượt Qua ?
subTitle:
Trong trading, nỗi đau khi cắt lỗ là thứ mà hầu như ai cũng phải trải qua, dù là người mới hay đã giao dịch nhiều năm. Cảm giác đó không chỉ đến từ số tiền bị mất, mà còn đến từ việc phải thừa nhận rằng nhận định của mình đã sai. Khi bấm nút cắt lỗ, trong đầu luôn xuất hiện hàng loạt suy nghĩ như “giá sắp quay đầu rồi”, “chỉ cần giữ thêm một chút nữa thôi”, hay “tại sao mình lại vào lệnh sớm như vậy”. Chính sự giằng co đó mới là điều khiến cắt lỗ trở nên đau đớn.
Con người vốn rất nhạy cảm với thua lỗ. Một khoản lỗ nhỏ có thể gây cảm xúc mạnh hơn rất nhiều so với một khoản lời tương đương. Vì vậy, khi cắt lỗ, trader không chỉ mất tiền mà còn mất cảm giác kiểm soát và sự tự tin vào bản thân. Nhiều người vì sợ cảm giác này mà chọn cách né tránh, dời stop loss, hoặc thậm chí không đặt stop loss ngay từ đầu, với hy vọng thị trường sẽ quay lại. Nhưng thực tế cho thấy, hy vọng hiếm khi cứu được tài khoản, mà thường chỉ khiến mức lỗ ngày càng lớn hơn.
Sự thật là cắt lỗ không phải dấu hiệu của thất bại, mà là dấu hiệu của sự chuyên nghiệp. Một lệnh cắt lỗ đúng lúc giúp tài khoản còn cơ hội để tiếp tục, giúp tâm lý không bị kéo xuống đáy, và quan trọng nhất là giúp trader giữ được sự tỉnh táo để đưa ra những quyết định tiếp theo. Ngược lại, không chịu cắt lỗ vì tiếc tiền hay vì cái tôi thường dẫn đến việc bị giam lệnh, tâm lý căng thẳng kéo dài và cuối cùng là những quyết định sai lầm liên tiếp.
Để vượt qua nỗi đau khi cắt lỗ, điều đầu tiên trader cần làm là thay đổi cách nhìn. Hãy xem cắt lỗ như một khoản chi phí bắt buộc trong trading, giống như phí giao dịch hay chi phí vận hành trong kinh doanh. Không có ai kiếm tiền bền vững trên thị trường mà chưa từng trả giá bằng những lệnh thua. Khi chấp nhận điều đó, cảm giác cắt lỗ sẽ nhẹ đi rất nhiều.
Bên cạnh đó, việc xác định điểm cắt lỗ ngay từ trước khi vào lệnh là vô cùng quan trọng. Khi mọi thứ đã được tính toán sẵn lúc đầu óc còn tỉnh táo, bạn sẽ không phải đấu tranh với cảm xúc ở thời điểm giá đi ngược. Lúc đó, cắt lỗ đơn giản chỉ là thực hiện đúng kế hoạch, chứ không phải là một quyết định đầy đau đớn.
Một yếu tố khác không kém phần quan trọng là tách cái tôi ra khỏi kết quả giao dịch. Thua một lệnh không nói lên năng lực hay giá trị của bạn. Trader giỏi không phải là người luôn đúng, mà là người kiểm soát được rủi ro và sai lầm tốt hơn số đông. Khi hiểu điều này, bạn sẽ bớt tự trách mình mỗi khi cắt lỗ và dễ dàng đứng lên cho những cơ hội tiếp theo.
Hãy học cách nhìn lại những lệnh cắt lỗ một cách khách quan. Có rất nhiều lệnh cắt lỗ là quyết định đúng, dù kết quả là âm tiền. Chúng bảo vệ tài khoản và giúp bạn tồn tại lâu hơn trên thị trường. Khi bạn có thể cắt lỗ mà không còn cay cú, không còn muốn trả thù thị trường, đó là lúc bạn đã bước sang một giai đoạn khác trong hành trình trading.
Cắt lỗ sẽ luôn mang lại cảm giác khó chịu, nhưng chính việc dám chấp nhận nỗi đau đó mới giúp trader trưởng thành. Thị trường không cần bạn đúng mọi lúc, nó chỉ cần bạn còn ở lại đủ lâu để nắm bắt những cơ hội thật sự.

title: Vitalik Buterin Admits Ethereum Drifted, Plans Cypherpunk Reset in 2026
subTitle:
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has acknowledged that the network has made significant compromises over the past ten years, particularly in its pursuit of scalability and mainstream adoption. In a statement released on January 16, Buterin outlined a new technical roadmap aimed at reversing what he described as a decade-long “regression” in decentralization.
According to Buterin, 2026 will mark a turning point, as Ethereum seeks to reclaim its original cypherpunk ethos, centered on individual sovereignty, privacy, and trust minimization.
Ethereum’s Scalability Trade-Offs and the Cost to Decentralization
Buterin admitted that Ethereum’s focus on scaling the network to support mass adoption has come at a cost. While these efforts improved usability and throughput, they also weakened the blockchain’s foundational promise of self-verification and independence from centralized intermediaries.
He pointed out that today’s Ethereum ecosystem relies heavily on centralized infrastructure, particularly trusted servers and Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs). Most users interact with the blockchain through third-party providers such as Infura or Alchemy, rather than verifying the chain themselves.
This architecture, according to Buterin, forces users to trust external data providers, undermining Ethereum’s trustless design and exposing users to censorship, surveillance, and data monetization risks.
Breaking Dependence on Centralized RPC Providers
To address this issue, Ethereum’s 2026 roadmap prioritizes the deployment of Helios and Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machines (ZK-EVMs).
These technologies are designed to democratize full-node verification, enabling everyday consumer hardware to locally verify blockchain data using Bridges and Local Verification (BAL) mechanisms.
By shifting verification to the network’s edge, Ethereum aims to eliminate the need for users to blindly trust centralized gateways. In practice, this would allow wallets and applications to independently confirm blockchain state without relying on intermediaries.
Privacy-First UX: ORAM and PIR Integration
Beyond decentralization, the roadmap places a strong emphasis on user privacy, particularly at the interface level.
Buterin proposed integrating cryptographic techniques such as:
Oblivious RAM (ORAM)
Private Information Retrieval (PIR)
These tools allow wallets to request blockchain data without revealing access patterns, effectively blinding RPC providers to user activity. This approach is intended to prevent the collection and resale of behavioral data, a growing concern in an ecosystem increasingly monitored by analytics firms.
If implemented successfully, these upgrades could place Ethereum in direct opposition to data-hungry surveillance models that have emerged around blockchain usage.
Improving Security Through Social Recovery and Time Locks
On the security front, Ethereum plans to standardize social recovery wallets and time-lock mechanisms. These tools aim to make fund recovery more intuitive while avoiding reliance on centralized custodians or cloud-based backups.
Buterin specifically warned against recovery methods that depend on major tech platforms, which could be vulnerable to hidden backdoors or external control. Social recovery and time locks are intended to provide resilience without sacrificing user autonomy.
Decentralized Interfaces to Reduce Front-End Risk
The roadmap also highlights the importance of securing the user interface layer. Ethereum plans to expand the use of decentralized storage protocols such as IPFS for hosting front-end interfaces.
This move reduces the risk of compromised or hijacked interfaces that could lock users out of their assets or redirect transactions maliciously. By decentralizing both the backend and frontend, Ethereum aims to deliver a more holistic trust-minimized experience.
A Long-Term Vision, Not an Overnight Fix
Buterin cautioned that these changes will not arrive all at once. He emphasized that the upcoming Kohaku release, as well as subsequent hard forks, will only deliver incremental progress.
“It will be a long road. We will not have everything we want in the next Kohaku release, or the next hard fork, or the hard fork after that. But it will turn Ethereum into an ecosystem worthy not only of its current place in the universe, but of a much greater one,” Buterin said.
What This Means for Ethereum’s Future
The 2026 agenda represents a fundamental rethinking of how Ethereum manages trust, privacy, and decentralization. Rather than prioritizing growth at all costs, the network appears poised to re-anchor itself in its original values—while still supporting a global user base.
Whether Ethereum can successfully balance usability with cypherpunk principles remains to be seen, but the roadmap signals a clear shift in philosophical direction for the world’s second-largest blockchain.

title: Se você ainda está procurando “o próximo Bitcoin”, sua carteira já está errada
subTitle:
Apenas minha opinião, não recomendação de ativos!
O maior erro de quem investe em cripto hoje não é comprar a moeda errada.
É montar carteira como se ainda existisse um “próximo Bitcoin” escondido em algum canto do mercado.
Esse erro leva sempre ao mesmo lugar:
muitas moedas, posições pequenas, retorno diluído e a sensação constante de que “quase deu certo”.
O mercado já mostrou como recompensa capital: concentração em poucos ativos certos, não pulverização em narrativas.
Uma carteira eficiente hoje NÃO tenta ser criativa
Ela tenta ser funcional.
Isso significa aceitar que:
ninguém vai pegar outro BTC a centavosretornos vêm de ciclos, não de milagreserrar pouco é mais importante do que acertar tudo
Com isso em mente, uma carteira enxuta e eficiente hoje gira em torno de quatro ativos, cada um com um papel claro.
Bitcoin: ainda é base, não aposta
Bitcoin não entra na carteira para “multiplicar rápido”.
Entra porque:
continua sendo o ativo que define os ciclosconcentra liquidezreduz risco estrutural da carteira
Ignorar BTC por achar que “já subiu demais” costuma sair caro nos momentos de stress do mercado.
➡️ Indicativo de compra:
Fases de tédio, lateralização ou quando BTC está sendo ignorado enquanto altcoins fazem barulho. Não é ativo para FOMO, é para posição contínua.
Ethereum: onde o dinheiro institucional passa
Ethereum é a infraestrutura central do mercado.
Não é sobre narrativa. É sobre uso real, L2s, tokenização, integração com TradFi.
Quem subestima ETH costuma olhar só para preço e esquecer que:
boa parte do ecossistema depende delequando o mercado amadurece, ETH costuma recuperar protagonismo
➡️ Indicativo de compra:
Períodos em que ETH está “chato”, andando menos que o resto do mercado, especialmente contra BTC. Normalmente é onde a relação risco/retorno fica mais interessante.
Solana: o motor de crescimento da carteira
Solana não é hedge, não é base.
É alavanca.
SOL costuma:
cair mais nas correçõessubir mais nas expansões
É exatamente por isso que faz sentido ter posição relevante, e não simbólica.
➡️ Indicativo de compra:
Após correções longas, períodos de consolidação e quando o ativo deixa de ser manchete. Comprar SOL em euforia normalmente significa pagar prêmio desnecessário.
Chainlink: infraestrutura que cresce junto com tudo
Enquanto muita gente fica trocando de L1 em L1, Chainlink cumpre um papel menos óbvio e mais eficiente: conectar o mundo real aos contratos inteligentes.
LINK não depende de “qual blockchain vai vencer”.
Ele cresce se o ecossistema crescer.
➡️ Indicativo de compra:
Bases longas, pouca atenção do mercado e ausência de hype. LINK costuma performar melhor quando ninguém está falando dele.
O erro que destrói retorno: colocar “um pouquinho” em tudo
R$ 200 em dez moedas diferentes não é diversificação.
É adiamento de decisão.
Mesmo que uma dessas moedas faça 5x ou 10x, o impacto final será irrelevante. Enquanto isso, uma posição bem dimensionada em um ativo certo muda o resultado da carteira inteira.
Carteiras boas aceitam que:
algumas posições vão errarpoucas vão acertaressas poucas precisam ser grandes o suficiente para importar
Cripto hoje não paga curiosidade, paga convicção
Não é mais um mercado para “testar moedas”.
É um mercado para construir posições.
BTC, ETH, SOL e LINK cobrem:
baseinfraestruturacrescimentoexposição transversal
O resto é ruído, distração ou aposta de curto prazo.

title: Japan’s Gold Reserves Surge 60% in 2025: Is This Bullish or Bearish for Bitcoin?
subTitle:
The 2025 market cycle has highlighted a growing divergence across global asset classes, particularly between traditional safe havens and risk-oriented assets. Amid rising macroeconomic uncertainty—driven in part by renewed tariff threats under former US President Donald Trump—capital has increasingly rotated toward conventional stores of value, placing pressure on speculative and high-volatility assets.
This shift has been especially evident in the contrasting performance of gold (XAU) and Bitcoin (BTC).
From a technical perspective, gold closed the fourth quarter with a 12% gain, while Bitcoin declined by 23% over the same period. On a broader 12-month timeframe, the divergence becomes even more pronounced: gold surged 65%, while Bitcoin slipped 6.3%, reinforcing the narrative of capital favoring traditional safe havens.
BTC/XAU Ratio Signals a Structural Shift
As a result of this divergence, the BTC/XAU ratio has reverted to levels seen prior to the US election cycle. In practical terms, the amount of gold required to purchase one Bitcoin has fallen by nearly half.
This raises a critical question for investors:
Is Bitcoin weakening fundamentally, or is gold simply outperforming due to extraordinary macro conditions?
According to AMBCrypto, this capital rotation dynamic is likely to play a key role in shaping Bitcoin’s next major move. With the Bank of Japan (BOJ) approaching a pivotal policy meeting, macro-driven flows are once again taking center stage—potentially marking a turning point for BTC.
Japan’s Gold Accumulation Adds Pressure on Bitcoin Flows
Japan’s economic challenges continue to draw global attention. The country faces:
The highest debt-to-GDP ratio in the world
Status as the largest foreign holder of US Treasuries
Persistent inflation hovering around 3%
These factors have fueled growing concerns over systemic risk and long-term economic stability.
Against this backdrop, Japan’s gold reserves have surged by 60% year-over-year, reaching approximately $120 billion in 2025—double the level recorded in 2022. This aggressive accumulation appears far from coincidental.
Gold’s renewed appeal as a defensive asset has intensified capital rotation away from Bitcoin, particularly as institutional and sovereign actors reassess portfolio risk in an increasingly fragile global environment.
From a technical standpoint, this shift is clearly reflected in the XAU/BTC ratio, which continues to trend in favor of gold.
BOJ Policy Expectations and Capital Rotation Risks
On the policy front, the current environment suggests this may only be the beginning. With inflation remaining elevated, expectations are rising that the Bank of Japan may adjust interest rates, a move that could further influence cross-asset capital flows.
As investors position themselves ahead of potential BOJ policy changes, both gold and Bitcoin volatility have become focal points. Some analysts interpret the recent pullback in precious metals not as weakness, but as a strategic repositioning—clearing liquidity to re-enter positions once clearer policy signals emerge.
In this context, the possibility of another capital rotation from Bitcoin into gold cannot be ruled out, particularly if macro uncertainty intensifies.
What This Means for Bitcoin in the 2025 Cycle
The 2025 cycle has placed macro-driven capital flows at the forefront of Bitcoin’s price action. While BTC continues to hold long-term structural appeal, short- and medium-term performance appears increasingly sensitive to global monetary policy, sovereign balance sheet strategies, and risk-off sentiment.
Whether Bitcoin can reclaim its role as “digital gold” in this environment remains an open question—one that may hinge on how global investors respond to central bank decisions in the months ahead.

title: Ethereum Price Outlook: ETF Momentum, Rising Staking Demand, and Network Growth Fuel Bullish Bias
subTitle:
Ethereum (ETH) has regained upward momentum this week after a brief pullback in the previous session, signaling renewed confidence among market participants. The recovery has been largely driven by a strong combination of capital inflows into spot Ethereum ETFs, accelerating staking participation, and sustained growth across the Ethereum network.
As of this week, ETH has rebounded by approximately 5%, reinforcing a constructive short-term outlook. However, despite the improving fundamentals, Ethereum still faces notable technical resistance near key exponential moving averages (EMAs), suggesting that the path higher may not be entirely smooth.
Why Is Ethereum Up 5% This Week?
Spot Ethereum ETFs See Strong and Consistent Inflows
Spot Ethereum ETFs listed in the United States are on track to complete the week without recording any net outflows, a notable shift in market sentiment. According to data from SoSoValue, these funds attracted a total of $474.4 million in net inflows over four consecutive trading days, marking the longest inflow streak since November last year.
This sustained demand highlights growing institutional interest in Ethereum as a long-term digital asset exposure, particularly as ETH-based financial products gain broader acceptance in traditional markets.
Exchange Reserves Decline as Investors Accumulate ETH
The positive momentum in ETFs has quickly spilled over into the spot market. Data from CryptoQuant shows that approximately 175,000 ETH have been withdrawn from centralized exchanges and transferred to private wallets in recent days.
Such movements typically indicate accumulation behavior, as investors move assets off exchanges for long-term holding or staking purposes, thereby reducing immediate sell-side pressure.
Ethereum Staking Reaches Record Highs
Ethereum’s staking ecosystem continues to expand at an unprecedented pace. Both the total amount of ETH staked and the validator entry queue have reached new all-time highs.
Total staked ETH is now approaching 36 million ETH
The validator queue has surged to 2.54 million ETH
A significant portion of recent staking inflows has reportedly come from Bitmine, an Ethereum treasury management firm, which staked approximately 1.68 million ETH within just one month. This surge underscores growing confidence in Ethereum’s long-term security model and yield-generating potential.
Network Activity and User Growth Accelerate
Beyond capital flows, Ethereum’s on-chain fundamentals are also strengthening. Network data shows:
Total transaction count hitting new records
Active addresses reaching their highest level in nearly six years
Notably, much of this growth is being driven by new users, rather than existing participants. Monthly activity retention (MoM) data indicates a sharp increase in engagement from first-time Ethereum addresses over the past 30 days, suggesting sustainable expansion of the ecosystem’s user base.
Ethereum Price Forecast: ETH Could Target $5,000 if Key Resistance Breaks
Futures Market Signals Weakening Bearish Pressure
Over the past 24 hours, the Ethereum derivatives market has recorded approximately $32.6 million in liquidations, with short positions accounting for $25.7 million, according to Coinglass data.
This imbalance suggests that bearish traders are increasingly being forced out of their positions, potentially paving the way for higher volatility to the upside.
Technical Structure: Ascending Triangle on the Weekly Chart
On the weekly timeframe, Ethereum continues to trade within an ascending triangle pattern, a technical structure often associated with bullish continuation.
Downside scenario:
ETH remains supported by an ascending trendline formed since November 17. If this support breaks, price could retreat toward the $2,890 demand zone.
Upside scenario:
A decisive breakout above the 20-week EMA, followed by a clear move beyond resistance levels at $3,470 and $3,670, would significantly strengthen the bullish case.
If confirmed, the measured move of the ascending triangle points to a potential upside target near $5,000, calculated by projecting the triangle’s height from the breakout level.
Momentum Indicators Suggest Consolidation Before Expansion
From a momentum perspective:
RSI remains near the neutral zone, indicating balanced market conditions
MACD histogram bars continue to contract below the zero line, signaling that selling pressure is gradually fading

title: Trump Signals Hesitation on Fed Chair Pick as Hassett Odds Fade: Who Could Replace Powell?
subTitle:
President Donald Trump has publicly signaled hesitation about appointing Kevin Hassett as the next Chair of the Federal Reserve, casting new uncertainty over one of the most widely discussed successors to Jerome Powell. Speaking at a recent conference, Trump suggested he prefers to keep Hassett in his current advisory role, citing concerns about losing a trusted and experienced voice within the White House.
That single remark was enough to reshape expectations across policy circles and financial markets. Hassett, who had been viewed as a front-runner ahead of Powell’s expected departure in May 2026, now appears less likely to make the move to the central bank.
Hassett’s Momentum Cools
Prior to Trump’s comments, Hassett was frequently mentioned as a leading candidate due to his close alignment with the administration and his influence on economic strategy. However, Trump’s reluctance to part with a key internal adviser suggests a preference for continuity within the executive branch rather than transferring that influence to the Fed.
Following the remarks, analyst discussions and prediction markets have begun shifting away from Hassett, reflecting a cooling of expectations around his candidacy.
Kevin Warsh Moves Into Focus
As Hassett’s odds fade, attention has increasingly turned to Kevin Warsh, a former Federal Reserve governor who served during the global financial crisis. Warsh’s experience inside the central bank and his long-standing credibility with financial markets have elevated him into the top tier of potential successors.
Warsh has historically appealed to Republicans seeking a clearer separation between monetary policy and day-to-day political influence. Trump’s apparent reluctance to reshuffle his inner circle has further strengthened Warsh’s position as a viable alternative.
A Crypto Lens: Warsh vs. Powell
From a digital assets perspective, the differences between Warsh and Powell appear more tonal than structural. Powell has consistently emphasized institutional stability, consumer protection, and regulatory clarity, particularly around stablecoins, exchanges, and market infrastructure. He has avoided framing crypto as money, while allowing innovation to develop within existing regulatory boundaries.
Warsh, by contrast, has expressed pragmatic skepticism. He has acknowledged Bitcoin’s potential role as a store of value, at times comparing it to gold, while remaining cautious about private cryptocurrencies functioning as everyday payment systems. This suggests a framework of tighter guardrails rather than outright opposition. While Warsh may sound more open to debate on crypto, policy outcomes under his leadership would likely remain conservative.
Powell’s Timeline and Market Expectations
Jerome Powell’s term as Fed Chair officially ends on May 15, 2026. While he could remain on the Board of Governors until 2028, history suggests most chairs step aside entirely after their term concludes.
With inflation moderating but not fully resolved, markets expect limited room for major policy shifts before Powell’s exit. Traders increasingly price in the possibility of one additional rate cut before the transition, assuming economic data allows. Any dramatic pivot now appears unlikely, reinforcing the view that the next Fed chair will shape policy direction for 2026 and beyond.
Powell also faces an unusual political backdrop. A Department of Justice probe related to his congressional testimony on cost overruns tied to the Fed’s headquarters renovation has included subpoenas for records. Powell has stated the matter does not affect monetary policy, but the investigation has intensified debate around central-bank independence as leadership change approaches.
What Comes Next?
Trump’s comments have reopened the Fed succession debate at a critical moment. With Hassett’s prospects dimming and Warsh gaining traction, markets are beginning to reassess what the post-Powell era could look like — not just for interest rates, but for regulation, financial stability, and the broader macro landscape that continues to shape crypto markets.

In trading, waiting for this matter almost determines whether you ultimately make money or are repeatedly harvested by the market. However, many people say they want to wait, but in reality, they have no idea what they are waiting for. Waiting is not about not trading, but about only making high-certainty trades.

First, wait for the structure to emerge. When the price has no structure, all directional judgments are emotional. Before a trend is formed, the fluctuations of K-line up and down are just noise. Don't rush to place orders in a half-baked market; the ups and downs you see are likely just the main force testing liquidity, not the start of a trend. The moment worth acting on is when the structure is complete and the direction is clear.

Second, wait for key positions. The market does not fluctuate randomly; prices will certainly respond to support, resistance, and densely traded areas. Chasing highs and lows is essentially moving away from the safety margin. Waiting is about waiting for the price to return to a position where you have an advantage, either confirming after a bounce on support or failing at a pullback on resistance. Acting at key levels makes your stop-loss meaningful and puts the risk-reward ratio in your favor.

Third, wait for emotions to be digested. After a big rise, market sentiment is extremely excited; after a big drop, panic selling is released in large quantities. These two phases are precisely the least suitable times for frequent operations. Be more willing to wait for emotions to cool down, for prices to return to a rational range, and then layout along the trend. It's not that you don't want to make money, but you know that rushing to make money often leads to losses.

Fourth, wait for your own stability. Many losses are not due to market errors but rather because people become chaotic first. When your emotions fluctuate, your positions are out of control, and you are continuously staring at the market, you simply do not have the conditions to make decisions. Real trading involves choosing to wait when in a state that is not suitable for you, rather than forcing entry.

So you will find that the number of trades does not depend on how many, but rather that each trade is not random. The market is there every day; if you wait correctly, entering the market is just a matter of convenience; if you wait incorrectly, even trying hard to execute is just a waste of effort. Trading is not about who is more diligent, but about who is more patient. The market will come, but it will only favor those who are prepared.

✅ May all trading enthusiasts maintain calmness and trade wisely, achieving financial freedom!

第一，等结构走出来，价格没有结构的时候，所有方向判断都是情绪。趋势没形成之前，K线的上下波动只是噪音。不要在半成品行情里着急下单，你看到的涨跌，很可能只是主力在测试流动性，而不是趋势启动。真正值得出手的，是结构完成、方向清晰的那一刻。

第二，等关键位置，市场不是随机波动的，价格一定会对支撑、压力、成交密集区产生反应。追涨追跌，本质上是在远离安全边际。而等，是等价格回到你有优势的位置，要么是回踩支撑后的确认，要么是反抽压力位的失败。在关键位出手，你的止损才有意义，盈亏比才站在你这边。

第三，等情绪被消化，大涨之后，市场情绪极度亢奋；大跌之后，恐慌盘大量释放。这两个阶段，恰恰是最不适合频繁操作的时间段。要更愿意等情绪冷却，等价格回归理性区间，再顺着趋势去布局。不是不想赚钱，而是知道急着赚钱，往往赚不到钱。

第四，等自己稳定，很多亏损，不是行情错了，是人先乱了。当你情绪波动、仓位失控、连续盯盘的时候，你根本不具备做决策的条件。真正的交易，会在不适合自己的状态下选择等待，而不是强行进场。

所以会发现，交易次数并不在于多，但每一单都不随意。市场每天都在，等对了，进场只是顺手的事；等错了，再努力执行也是白忙一场。交易不是比谁更勤奋，而是比谁更有耐心，行情会来，但只会给准备好的人

title: “嘴撸时代结束，X 创作时代正式开启。”
subTitle:
针对 2026 年 X 平台最新政策的「深度解析」

X 提升了创作者的收入，很多加密 KOL 两周“创做收益”超 3000 美金 💲

靠“刷量”、“互助”或者发发废话就能薅羊毛的阶段已经过去了。

随着马斯克宣布 2026 为“创作者元年”，X 的算法进行了一场毁灭性的“洗牌”，但也为真正的创作者打开了通往高额收入的大门。

我们该如何在这波红利中赚到“马爸爸”的高薪。

一、X 的底层意图：从“互动”转向“价值展示”

以前，你的收益取决于回复区的广告展示；现在，X 彻底变天了。

1. 首页时间线（Home Timeline）是唯一战场

现在的收益计算不再看你回复区有多少人吵架，而是基于已验证高级用户在首页动态看到你帖子的真实浏览量。
 • 潜台词：平台希望你出现在用户的“For You”推荐页里，而不是猥琐地躲在别人的大帖下刷存在感。

2. 内容的“阶级分化”

X 官方明确表示，**文章（Articles）**等长篇形式的权重将高于短篇内容。
 • 意图：X 正在从一个“碎片化资讯站”转型为“深度内容社区”。马斯克想抢的是 Substack 和 YouTube 的蛋糕。

3. “含金量”决定收益

高级会员（Premium / Premium+）的浏览量比普通用户值钱得多。
 • 解读：你不需要吸引所有人，你只需要吸引那些“付过费的人”。你的内容越硬核、越能吸引高净值人群，你的单价就越高。

二、创作者如何提升“姿势”，获取暴利？

既然规则变了，玩家的策略也必须进化。想拿 3000 美金的工资？你需要做到以下三点：

1. 从“博主”变身为“作者”

不要再发那种只有两行字的感慨。利用 X 的 Articles 功能。
 • 实操：如果你是在加密圈（Web3），不要只发“冲什么”，要发“为什么冲”的深度逻辑。深度长文不仅能获得更高的收益权重，还能通过逻辑征服高级会员，增加你的“高价值展示次数”。

2. 拥抱“首页算法”，而非“回复算法”

以前流行在热门贴下“蹭流量”，现在这种行为几乎不产生收益。
 • 实操：你的推文必须具备独立生存能力。用钩子（Hook）开头，配合高质量的图片或视频。如果你的内容能让用户在首页停留超过 5 秒，系统会认为这是“高价值内容”并推送给更多 Premium 用户。

3. 建立“真实的人格特征”

X 正在利用 AI 强力打击欺诈和不真实互动。任何机械化的刷量、AI 自动生成的废话都会被处罚甚至封号。
 • 实操：说人话，有立场，带温度。哪怕是吐槽，也要吐槽得有灵魂。2026 年的创作者，核心竞争力是“信任感”。只有用户愿意追随你，你的每一条动态才会出现在他们的首页，从而转化成美金。

三、给创作者的建议：别在“红海”里内卷

quoteContent.title: Bitcoin’s Drop From $126K to $80K: Analyst Says Market Psychology Drove the Sell-Off
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly: Bitcoin’s sharp pullback from $126,000 to $80,000 was largely driven by market psychology rather than fundamentals, according to crypto analyst Plan C.In a post on X, Plan C explained that the decline reflects speculative behavior and flawed probability thinking among traders. He compared the situation to flipping a coin three times and landing on heads each time — a scenario that often leads participants to falsely assume the next outcome must reverse.This mindset, known as the gambler’s fallacy, triggered widespread selling as market participants assumed Bitcoin’s rally had become statistically “overdue” for a correction.Rather than responding to on-chain weakness or macro deterioration, traders reacted to perceived patterns and emotional expectations, amplifying volatility.Plan C noted that such behavior is common in financial markets, particularly in crypto, where price action is often driven by sentiment, positioning, and collective psychology more than traditional valuation metrics.

title: Ethereum’s Rapid Rise to $500B: Why ETH May Still Be Undervalued
subTitle:
Ethereum Reached $500B in Under 6 Years, Why ETH’s Valuation Still Trails Its Onchain Dominance

Overview:
Ethereum reached $500B faster than any major asset, but still accounts for only a fraction of total crypto market value despite hosting most DeFi, stablecoin, and on-chain settlement activity.ETH’s narrative has lagged its utility, as technical complexity and gradual upgrades have kept Ethereum underappreciated outside institutional and developer circles.Technically, ETH remains constructive, holding above key moving averages, with bullish momentum intact as long as support near $3,100-$3,150 holds.
Ethereum’s rise to the $500 billion market valuation is a historic milestone. It’s not easy to reach this level in under six years from launch, and that too, faster than any major corporation, commodity, or digital asset. Yet, despite this speed, Ethereum’s current valuation tells a more restrained story that appears disconnected from the scale of economic activity the network supports.
Ethereum’s Economic Footprint vs Market Pricing
Ethereum today hosts the majority of on-chain economic activity. It is the settlement layer for decentralized finance, the leading platform for stablecoin transfers, and the base layer for tokenized assets, NFTs, and a growing share of institutional blockchain experiments.
Despite this, ETH still represents only a fraction of the total cryptocurrency market capitalization. In relative terms, the market continues to price Ethereum closer to a “secondary asset” than to indispensable infrastructure. 
That contrast becomes sharper when compared with Bitcoin, which has a significantly larger share of total market value despite having a narrower functional scope.
Bitcoin reached a $500 billion valuation over a much longer timeframe, yet it has retained its crown as ‘digital gold.’ 
Ethereum, by contrast, reached the same milestone faster but has struggled to sustain a comparable narrative despite its broader economic role.
Also Read: Bank of Italy Warns ETH Death Spiral Could Freeze $800 Billion in Assets
Why Narrative Has Lagged Utility
One reason for this imbalance lies in Ethereum’s complexity. Bitcoin’s value proposition is simple and easily communicated: scarcity, security, and monetary hedge characteristics. 
Ethereum’s proposition is multifaceted smart contracts, settlement, computation, and composability, which makes it harder to frame as a single investment.
Additionally, Ethereum’s evolution has been gradual and technical. Upgrades, scaling improvements, and fee-market changes tend to be absorbed quietly by the ecosystem rather than celebrated as headline events. 
As a result, Ethereum’s role often goes unnoticed outside of developer and institutional circles, even as on-chain volumes continue to grow.
This has left ETH in an unusual position: economically central, but narratively understated.
Technical Structure
Ethereum’s price rose more than 7% on Tuesday and consolidated around the 200-day EMA at $3,338 over the next two days. At the press time, ETH is trading 1.79% down, failing to close above this resistance level. 
If ETH closes above the 200-day EMA at $3,338, it could extend the rally toward the December 10 high of $3,447. 
A close above this level could extend gains toward the next resistance at $3,592. Ethereum’s RSI and MACD indicators signal bullishness.
However, if ETH fails to close above the 200-day EMA and extends its correction, it could decline toward the 50-day EMA at $3,154.
Also Read: BTC Gains Strategic Relevance Beyond Price During Venezuela Shock
The Valuation Gap: What the Market May Be Missing
Ethereum’s rapid rise to $500 billion was not driven by hype alone. It reflected real adoption, real usage, and real economic settlement. 
Since reaching that milestone, Ethereum’s adoption base has expanded further, yet valuation multiples have not followed at the same pace.
This creates a growing mismatch:
Ethereum secures a majority of public blockchain economic activityEthereum facilitates trillions in annual stablecoin settlementEthereum serves as the base layer for DeFi and tokenization
And yet, ETH is still valued as though its role were optional rather than foundational.
The implication is not necessarily that ETH must immediately reprice higher, but that capital allocation has not fully adjusted to Ethereum’s systemic importance. 
Over time, markets tend to fill such gaps either through valuation expansion or through a shift in how investors classify the asset.
Looking Ahead
If ETH can maintain structural support above $3,100 and continues trading higher, the next technical challenge near $3,300 becomes increasingly likely. Beyond that, longer-term valuation will depend less on short-term momentum and more on whether markets start to value Ethereum for what it already is, not just a smart contract platform, but the settlement backbone of the digital asset economy.

title: 区块链发展十年
subTitle:
我们把时间拉回10年前，当时原作者是20来岁😆 - 

现在二十来岁的人，根本无法意识到他们有多幸运。因为意识不到，所以他们不会手舞足蹈，不会夜不能寐，不会意识到自己正站在历史的裂缝之上。

他们按部就班地去上课、考试、实习，给父母一个交代；
在游戏、社交网络和廉价的娱乐里消磨时间；在一次次毫无意义的聚会后，收获对未来的模糊与空白。

人，无法同时读过比特币白皮书、理解“私钥即主权”，
却又对自己的人生完全放弃掌控感。

而我们这些三十来岁的人，看着他们，FOMO 大到恨不得和二十岁的人换命、换身。

我们已经清楚地意识到：时间，正在我们身上开始收紧；
却刚刚在他们那里，撒下第一层迷魂的粉尘。让他们误以为时间像一枚刚铸好的硬币，厚实、沉重，怎么花都花不完。

一个刚上大一的年轻人，只要在 2013 年点开那份 PDF，读完《Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System》，只要理解“去中心化”“不可篡改”“无需许可”，

再往前一步，看见以太坊，把“钱”第一次变成可编程的协议，他距离改变自己命运，是那么地近。

挖矿、跑节点、参与早期社区、哪怕什么都不做，只需要买一点，拿住，不下牌桌，都足以在几年后完成一次阶层意义上的跃迁。

这是怎样的世界？只用一层薄薄的、名为 HODL的纸膜，
就把天量的人拦在了历史的门外。

他们看见狮子在草原上行走，却像牛群一样熟视无睹；
他们听见远处雷鸣滚动，却依旧成群结队地走进课堂、走进招聘会，低头啃草。

我身边的年轻亲戚、朋友，只因为我多说了两句比特币、以太坊，就已经流露出不耐烦的神情。

天啊！

他们刚刚花几百块买了一台新手机、买了一款新游戏，
却完全无法理解：同样的几百块钱，在这个时间点，意味着什么。

我真想告诉他们：那不是一串代码，那不是一场投机；那是一次文明层级的协议升级，是人类第一次尝试在没有中心的情况下，重新定义“信任”。

你可以轻松下载、复制、使用你看到的一切——
这是 Web2 时代的互联网故事。

你可以轻松铸造、转移、持有你看到的一切——
这是比特币与以太坊开启的加密时代故事。

拿着锤子的人，看什么都像钉子。

而现实是：
不管你是否同意，锤子都会砸向它能砸到的一切，
去测试那些旧有结构，是否还能被称为“必然”。

就像人类曾经把蒸汽机塞进马车、缝纫机、纺织厂，
根本不在乎它们是否是最佳场景。

区块链，比蒸汽机更抽象，也更残忍。它像一种新的力场，正在渗入货币、金融、组织、信任的每一条缝隙，同样不关心人们是否理解、是否接受。

这从来不是“要不要参与”的问题。而是赤裸裸的——
To be or not to be。

教育、主流金融、传统机构的反应，在当时慢得像老年人的回头。真正站在前沿的人，看着这一切，就像站在时间快进的一侧，看着世界另一端的慢动作。

房间的门已经打开了。大象已经走进来了。新世界的气味，已经被象耳扇进每个人的鼻腔。

只是人们，不约而同地，选择了沉默。

تعود أسواق العملات الرقمية للتركيز مجدداً على متداول بارز معروف برهاناته الاتجاهية الكبيرة. هذا المتداول، الذي غالباً ما يُربط بفترة انهيار السوق التاريخي المعروفة بـ 1011، أعاد بناء تعرض قوي عبر أبرز الأصول الرقمية. وتُظهر بيانات البلوكشين ومنصات تتبع المشتقات مراكز شراء بالرافعة المالية تتجاوز 900 مليون دولار. هذا التطور أعاد إشعال النقاشات حول ثقة السوق، وتوقيت الدخول، واحتمالات استمرار الاتجاه. ويتابع المتداولون هذه المحفظة عن كثب بسبب توافقها المتكرر مع نقاط التحول الكبرى في السوق. فقد ظهرت مراكزه السابقة غالباً خلال فترات التماسك، وليس خلال موجات الصعود المفرطة. ويشير هذا النمط إلى تمركز محسوب أكثر منه مضاربة عاطفية. ومع اقتراب الأرباح غير المحققة من 40 مليون دولار، تتزايد الثقة حول هذا التداول الذي يقوم به حوت العملات الرقمية.
حجم رأس المال المستخدم يجعل هذه الخطوة صعبة التجاهل. مثل هذا التعرض يؤثر في السيولة، ومعنويات السوق، وتموضع المشتقات عبر منصات التداول. ونادراً ما يستخدم كبار المتداولين الرافعة المالية من دون قناعة هيكلية واضحة. هذا النشاط يعيد مرة أخرى سلوك الحيتان إلى صلب التحليل العام للسوق.

تعرض ضخم عبر بيتكوين وإيثيريوم وسولانا يعكس قناعة قوية
يمتد التعرض الحالي للمتداول عبر $BTC  و $ETH  و $SOL ، جامعاً بين الاستقرار وفرص العائد المرتفع. تظل بيتكوين حجر الأساس في هذا التمركز بفضل هيمنتها السوقية وعمق سيولتها. وتأتي إيثيريوم في المرتبة التالية، مدعومة بنمو استخدام الشبكة واهتمام المؤسسات. أما سولانا فتضيف عنصر تقلب يوفر إمكانية صعود أعلى، ما يزيد من العائد المحتمل الإجمالي للتداول.
تشير هذه المراكز بالرافعة المالية إلى ثقة في تعافٍ أوسع للسوق، وليس مجرد ارتفاعات معزولة لرموز محددة. التنويع يقلل الاعتماد على أداء أصل واحد. هذا النهج يشبه بناء المحافظ المؤسسية أكثر من المضاربة الفردية. ويرى محللون أن هذا الهيكل يعكس توزيع مخاطر منضبطاً.
الأرباح غير المحققة تبرز دقة التوقيت وفهم هيكل السوق
تبلغ الأرباح غير المحققة حالياً نحو 40 مليون دولار، استناداً إلى الأسعار السائدة في السوق. وتُقدَّر الأرباح التراكمية خلال الأشهر الماضية بنحو 135 مليون دولار. هذه الأرقام تعكس تنفيذاً قوياً، لا استخداماً متهوراً للرافعة المالية. الدخول قرب مناطق دعم رئيسية حسّن بشكل كبير من ملف المخاطر.
غالباً ما يبني هذا المتداول مراكزه خلال فترات عدم اليقين. تردد السوق يخلق في كثير من الأحيان فرص تسعير خاطئة. الإعداد الحالي يتماشى مع هذا السلوك التاريخي. ضغط الأسعار عبر الأصول الكبرى وفّر بيئة مناسبة للتجميع.
ازدادت النقاشات حول آفاق سعر إيثيريوم بعد صدور هذه البيانات. فعمليات تجميع الحيتان غالباً ما تسبق عودة السرديات المؤسسية. تحديثات الشبكة، والتقدم في التوسع، وديناميكيات التخزين، تواصل دعم قوة إيثيريوم على المدى المتوسط. وهذه العوامل تتماشى مع استراتيجية تموضع المتداول.
المراكز بالرافعة المالية غالباً ما تعكس استراتيجيات بأسلوب مؤسسي
عادة ما تعكس المراكز الكبيرة بالرافعة المالية في العملات الرقمية قرارات منظمة. تستخدم المؤسسات والمتداولون المحترفون الرافعة كأداة، لا كرهان. حجم المراكز، وهوامش الأمان، وخطط الخروج هي ما يحدد النجاح. واستمرارية هذا المتداول تشير إلى إطار مهني واضح خلف الكواليس.
وتدعم بيانات المشتقات هذا التصور. فارتفاع الاهتمام المفتوح مستمر من دون قفزات حادة في معدلات التمويل. وهذا يدل على مشاركة متوازنة، لا تمركزات شراء مزدحمة. مثل هذه الظروف تميل إلى دعم اتجاهات مستدامة بدلاً من انعكاسات حادة.
هذا التداول الذي يقوم به حوت العملات الرقمية ينسجم بوضوح مع هذا السياق. فهو يعكس جرأة محسوبة مدعومة بهيكل سوق مواتٍ. ويعزز هذا السلوك الثقة لدى المشاركين المحترفين الذين يراقبون تدفقات رأس المال الذكي.
ماذا يشير هذا التداول عالي القناعة لحوت العملات الرقمية في المرحلة المقبلة؟
مركز نشط بقيمة 900 مليون دولار يغير ديناميكيات السوق بشكل ملموس. مزودو السيولة يعدلون فروق الأسعار والتعرض. البائعون على المكشوف يعيدون تقييم المخاطر مع تزايد القناعة. متداولو الزخم يترقبون إشارات التأكيد.
هذا التداول لا يضمن ارتفاعات فورية في الأسعار. لكنه يزيد من احتمال استمرار الاتجاه بشكل منظم. الأنماط التاريخية تشير إلى الصبر أكثر من التقلبات الحادة. فالتجميع المستدام غالباً ما يسبق اتجاهات ممتدة.
في الوقت الحالي، يراقب المشاركون في السوق تدفقات البلوكشين وسلوك المشتقات عن كثب. أي توسع إضافي في المراكز قد يعزز السرديات الصاعدة. وفي المقابل، قد يؤدي جني أرباح جزئي إلى تقلبات مؤقتة. وفي الحالتين، تبقى الأسواق في حالة تفاعل وترقب.
